title: Account Executive, UK Public Sector
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Job Title: Account Executive, UK Public Sector

Reporting to: Director of Sales, UK & Ireland

Direct Reports: None

Location: UK (remote)

Travel expectations: Approximately 50%

Your Impact

As an Account Executive at Axon, you will play a key role in helping police forces across the UK adopt technology that saves lives, reduces risk to officers and the public, and enhances transparency and public trust. You will be supporting the adoption of Axon's ecosystem of products - including body-worn and in-car cameras, TASER devices, and cloud-based software platforms including our digital evidence management system - across forces in the UK. Your success will be measured by your ability to build and maintain senior-level relationships, drive large, complex opportunities through public sector procurement, and align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK policing. This is a quota-carrying, external field position.

At Axon, our goal is to make each individual feel valued for their contribution to the company's mission to protect life. We are looking for intelligent people who want to do remarkable things. We strive to create an environment where people can succeed and enjoy coming to work every day. Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. You will constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

What You'll Do

Develop and Execute Account Strategies: Create comprehensive account strategies that align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK police forces, focusing on officer safety, operational efficiency and digital transformation. This will require close collaboration with other internal members of the account team(s).

Drive Complex Sales Engagements: Manage long sales cycles, leading to high-value, multi-year agreements with forces and police-led collaboratives. Facilitate discovery meetings, present Axon's value propositions, and lead customer negotiations.

Help increase market share and achieve Axon's strategic objectives by maximising revenue and customer satisfaction within your designated forces and regions.

Support Public Safety Innovation: Partner with internal teams to present Axon's innovative public safety technologies - such as TASER 10, Axon Body 4, Axon Fleet, Axon Evidence, Axon Respond, Axon Fusus and Axon VR training - demonstrating how these solutions transform force operations and support national productivity and efficiency priorities.

Manage Customer Relationships: Cultivate relationships with both executive and operational leaders within police forces - including Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, Police and Crime Commissioners and their offices, Chief Finance Officers, Heads of Digital/IT and operational commanders. Ensure seamless customer experiences through proactive engagement and problem-solving.

Champion Public Safety Outcomes: Position Axon as a key enabler of UK policing priorities, helping forces meet their operational and safety goals while enhancing transparency, accountability and public confidence.

Collaborate with Internal Teams: Work closely with Axon's customer success, engineering and programme management teams to ensure that customer projects are delivered on time and that forces derive measurable value from Axon's solutions.

Navigate UK Public Sector Procurement: Work with force commercial and procurement teams, national frameworks and police-owned commercial routes to structure compliant, competitive routes to market, and manage the associated governance and approvals.

Accurate CRM Management: Maintain up-to-date records of customer interactions, opportunities and forecasts in Salesforce. Use this data to drive proactive sales strategies and ensure visibility for internal stakeholders.

Key Performance Indicators

Revenue Growth: Achieve or exceed annual revenue targets by closing high-value opportunities with UK police forces.

Market Penetration: Lead the expansion of Axon's solutions across UK policing.

Strategic Solution Selling: Collaborate with forces to identify and address their pain points through Axon's full suite of products, including Axon Records, Fleet and Evidence.com. Develop tailored solutions that result in improved officer safety, enhanced force transparency and streamlined workflows.

Executive Relationships: In conjunction with Axon UK leadership and other team members, establish and maintain high-trust relationships with senior leaders (Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, PCCs, CFOs, CIOs, etc.) within assigned forces, positioning Axon as a long-term partner in public safety technology.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Collaboration: Lead a cross-functional Axon team, including product, engineering and sales engineers, to ensure customer success and satisfaction, delivering 100% on all project commitments for assigned accounts. Develop strong relationships within the UK team and across other divisions throughout Axon to serve as an advocate for our UK customers.

Contract & Negotiation Leadership: Lead the proposal and negotiation process for contracts, ensuring competitive positioning and successful long-term engagements, including through framework call-offs and direct award processes where applicable.

What You'll Bring

Public Sector Sales Experience: Deep understanding of UK public sector procurement and the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

Solution-Oriented Mindset: Ability to translate complex customer needs into innovative Axon solutions, helping forces enhance public safety, officer accountability and efficiency.

Technical Acumen: Familiarity with cloud computing, SaaS solutions and (preferably) digital evidence management systems. Experience working with police IT and digital leaders to drive cloud and digital transformation initiatives.

Collaborative Leadership: Proven ability to work cross-functionally within an organisation to deliver comprehensive, high-impact customer solutions. Leadership experience in managing multi-stakeholder projects is a plus.

Law Enforcement/Public Safety Knowledge: Experience working with UK police forces or wider public safety agencies is a strong plus. Ability to connect Axon's mission and products to the unique challenges of UK policing - including the regulatory, ethical and data protection scrutiny that surrounds police technology.

title: Sr Clinical Research Associate (Spain)
description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of clinical trials by independently managing clinical site monitoring and site management activities across Spain and Portugal, from study start-up through close-out. You will act as a primary point of contact for investigative sites in these countries, ensuring compliance with protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations and study requirements while supporting high-quality patient data and study delivery.

This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for supporting site performance, resolving issues, maintaining study documentation and providing guidance and mentorship to junior CRAs. You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, sponsors and other cross-functional teams in a dynamic clinical research environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently conduct and document onsite and remote monitoring activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits across Portugal and Spain.
  • Ensure investigative sites comply with study protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, SOPs and project-specific requirements.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned sites, managing site-related questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations through to resolution.
  • Review clinical trial data, source documentation and study systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, data integrity and compliance.
  • Support site selection, activation and recruitment activities, working with sites to achieve study milestones and patient recruitment targets.
  • Ensure sites are appropriately trained on protocols, study systems, processes and applicable requirements throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Maintain oversight of essential study documentation, including ISF and TMF, ensuring documents are complete, accurate and filed in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with sponsors, project teams, vendors and investigative sites to support study timelines, resolve issues and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Participate in audits and inspections, Investigator Meetings, study meetings and other project activities as required.
  • Provide mentoring and support to CRA I and II colleagues, participate in co-monitoring and CRA assessment activities, and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (Honours) in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is preferred.
  • 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience, with 7–9 years preferred.
  • Strong clinical site monitoring experience across clinical trial activities from site start-up through close-out.
  • Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical research principles and applicable local regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with Phase I–IV clinical trials preferred.
  • Proficiency with clinical trial systems such as EDC, IRT, eTMF, CTMS and Microsoft Office, with experience in systems such as Medidata Rave or Oracle InForm preferred.
  • Strong understanding of site management, including site activation, recruitment, training, issue resolution and maintenance of essential documentation.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with investigative sites, sponsors and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organisational, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, with a high level of attention to detail and a sense of urgency.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate sound judgement and manage competing priorities in a results-driven environment.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting junior CRAs is preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project requirements and geographic location.
  • Valid driver’s licence required.
  • Fluent written and verbal English, Spanish and Portuguese

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

title: Regulatory Coordinator
description:

title: Product Manager, Technical
description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimise operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimised consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As a Technical Product Manager, you support and drive strategic product initiatives. You quickly build a clear understanding of platform technical capabilities and limitations to translate business needs into precise requirements. You help manage projects from planning through launch, maintaining end-to-end ownership across roadmap development, release readiness, and post-launch enablement. You work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Client Success teams to prioritize and deliver impactful solutions. You use data, client feedback, and market insights to make informed product decisions, improve product value, and support successful adoption.

Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working.

Responsibilities

  • Support Senior Product Manager across strategic operations workstreams.
  • Translate business priorities into clear technical product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans, leading scoping calls and producing crisp written outputs.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Client Success to define, prioritize, and deliver high-impact capabilities.
  • Drive execution across discovery, planning, development, testing, release, and post-launch iteration, taking end-to-end ownership of roadmap development projects from requirements through delivery, release readiness, and post-development documentation and enablement.
  • Establish and maintain an intake and triage rhythm for enhancement requests and operational work, ensuring consistent capture of context, impact, dependencies, and recommended priority for leadership decisions.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized view of top platform risks and recurring operational gaps, surfacing risks early and clearly to product leadership to support prioritization decisions.
  • Manage cross-functional alignment, dependencies, timelines, risks, and status reporting across multiple initiatives.
  • Analyze data, client feedback, and market signals to inform product decisions and improve feature value.
  • Oversee product documentation, release notes, internal enablement materials, and stakeholder communications.
  • Support client and internal team discussions to clarify requirements, validate use cases, and ensure successful adoption.
  • Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) to accelerate and elevate outcomes, including communication drafting, data analysis, prompt engineering, and documentation.

Qualifications

  • Experience working closely with Engineering and Data Science teams on APIs, data workflows, analytics, or automation capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous requests into clear requirements (user stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation) and drive work to completion across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience reading and interpreting API requirements and technical documentation (REST concepts, authentication patterns, payloads, and webhooks fundamentals).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Advanced degree in a related field.
  • Experience with the Rithum for Brands (ChannelAdvisor) platform.
  • Intrapreneurial/founder mindset.
  • Experience with AI tooling for documentation, requirements gathering, and/or building solutions.
  • Integration-heavy environment exposure (APIs, webhooks).
  • Experience using tooling commonly associated with technical delivery and operations (JIRA, Notion, backlog tools, documentation tooling, and basic data analysis).

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

Benefits

  • Life insurance & disability benefits

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:

Role will include management of clinical trial applications to Competent Authorities, Ethics Committees and Regulatory Agencies, and the research, review and reporting on applicable global regulations and requirements. Develop stakeholder tools, process/document regulatory risk assessments, and provide support, expertise and represent the unit with other functional units, sponsors, researchers and/or regulatory authorities. Ensure high quality, timely service delivery processes are maintained in accordance with corporate, industry and regulatory standards and guidelines. May be required to coach peers and/or provide input for staff performance reviews.

Unit Management

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customer’s broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

About the role

As a Talent Operations Specialist on our Global Talent Team, you’ll be the engine behind how we hire, combining sharp coordination, smart systems and a strategic mindset to help us hire smarter, faster and better.

This role blends exceptional interview coordination with talent strategy support and ownership of our TA operations. You'll use automation and AI to free up recruiter capacity, keep our hiring systems and vendors running smoothly, and raise the bar on the experience we give candidates and hiring leaders. This role reports to our Senior Director of Global GTM Recruiting, and supports a global team across the US, EMEA & APJ.

About Global Talent at Dataiku

We're not just filling roles. We're building the strongest possible teams, aligned to real business needs and backed by a world-class approach to talent. Our Global Talent exists to act as partners to the business and make talent a strategic lever rather than a reactive function.

  • Join a forward-looking Global Talent function at a company shaping the future of AI.
  • Work in a global, collaborative environment that values curiosity, precision and impact.
  • Play a hands-on role across the talent lifecycle, from how talent is identified and evaluated to how it's hired and supported.

What you'll do

Interview scheduling and candidate experience

  • Own end-to-end interview scheduling across regions and time zones, streamlining scheduling and pipeline tasks with automation tools and AI agents.
  • Deliver a best-in-class candidate experience from first outreach to offer.
  • Be the trusted logistics partner for recruiters and hiring managers.
  • Identify and implement low-lift, high-impact process improvements.

Talent strategy

  • Support talent mapping and the building of proactive talent pools.
  • Help prepare calibration sessions and post-hire reviews.
  • Put Dataiku's competency framework into practice across hiring and talent workflows.

TA operations and systems

What you'll need to be successful

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in recruiting coordination, recruiting operations or a fast-paced People function.
  • Hands-on experience with Greenhouse or a similar ATS, and familiarity with tools such as GoodTime, BrightHire, Gem or AI agents.
  • Experience administering recruiting systems and integrations (for example, Greenhouse and Workday) and managing vendor relationships.
  • A solid understanding of candidate data privacy and hiring compliance.
  • You're highly organized and calm under pressure, and you enjoy working through complexity and ambiguity.
  • You're comfortable working across cultures, time zones and competing priorities.
  • You're excited by automation and AI, and eager to apply them in your day-to-day work.
  • You communicate clearly and confidently with candidates, recruiters and executives alike.
  • You're curious, detail-oriented and mission-driven.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to competency-based hiring or performance frameworks.

#LI-CM

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

title: Regional Sales Director - Richmond
description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

HR Technology & Analytics Specialist

HR Technology Support

title: Director of US Government Engagement
description:
About the team

At Q-CTRL, the Government Engagement team works at the intersection of policy, international engagement, and national security to influence how governments govern and fund the development and adoption of quantum technologies. As trusted and respected leaders in the sector, we build enduring relationships with politicians, policymakers, and defense forces around the world to secure opportunities for Q-CTRL to deliver cutting-edge sovereign capability. We empower all areas of the business to understand and navigate government decision-making.

About the role
Reporting to the Global Head of Government Engagement, you’ll lead Q-CTRL’s US government engagement activities, working closely with our business development, technical, product, and marketing teams. You’ll shape policy and funding initiatives, build trusted relationships, and secure opportunities for Q-CTRL to partner commercially and strategically with government to deliver quantum computing and quantum sensing capabilities that advance US defense and economic interests.

What you'll be doing:

  • Develop and execute Q-CTRL’s US government engagement strategy, setting clear priorities for policy, legislative, and funding outcomes that support our growth and the adoption of quantum technologies.
  • Build and maintain trusted, bipartisan relationships with congressional offices and committees, the Department of War, federal agencies and state governments.
  • Serve as a trusted representative of company interests in political and policy forums, including engagements supporting business development with the USG.
  • Shape policy, legislation, and funding decisions through targeted advocacy, including developing proposals for authorization and appropriations processes and building support among key decision-makers.
  • Work closely with business development and technical colleagues to identify, assess, and secure government funding and partnership opportunities, connecting Q-CTRL’s capabilities with government priorities and mission needs.
  • Monitor and anticipate policy, legislative, budget, and regulatory developments, translating them into timely advice and recommended actions for company leadership.
  • Represent Q-CTRL in industry associations, think tanks, and policy forums, building coalitions that advance shared priorities and establish Q-CTRL as a trusted voice on quantum technology.
  • Other duties within the Employee's skills and experience, or with reasonable training.

Ideally you'll have:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in government, congressional affairs, public policy, or government relations, for example as a congressional staffer, government official, military officer, or lobbyist.
  • A demonstrated track record of shaping government decisions, with tangible achievements in policy development, legislation, or public funding.
  • A strong understanding of US federal policymaking and the legislative, authorization, appropriations, and agency budget processes, including when and how to engage effectively.
  • An established network across Capitol Hill, the executive branch, key federal departments, and the ability to build trusted relationships across political affiliations and institutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, persuasive arguments tailored to government audiences.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work across business functions to raise Q-CTRL’s profile and secure commercial opportunities.

It would be fantastic if you have these skills/experience but not essential:

  • Experience working with the Department of War and congressional defense committees, including familiarity with defense budgets, acquisition pathways, and the transition of emerging technologies into operational use.
  • Experience working in a technology startup or scaleup, particularly in a role connecting government engagement with commercial growth.
  • Experience in the advanced technology, defense, or aerospace sectors.
  • Experience shaping policy or funding for quantum or other critical technologies, such as AI, semiconductors, space, or advanced sensing.
  • Experience with state government engagement, economic development initiatives, and allied technology cooperation through frameworks such as AUKUS.

Compensation

Additional Information

We take a multidisciplinary approach to quantum computing research, bringing together experts from diverse fields. We particularly value versatile and self-motivated problem solvers. If you are passionate about making quantum computers useful, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet all of the requirements listed above.

Salary

The targeted base salary range for this position is between $210,000 - $260,000 and will ultimately be determined by specific job-related skills, experience, level, location and other contributing factors. This role will be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and the opportunity to equity and other forms of compensation outside of the targeted base salary range.

This position is eligible for Q-CTRL's U.S. health insurance benefits, subject to plan eligibility requirements, as well as HSA, FSA, PTO, Company paid parental leave, 401k with an employer match, and a Learning, Development and Wellness allowance. For more information on benefits at Q-CTRL, please visit our careers page at https://q-ctrl.com/careers.

Should you have any questions related to the compensation package, please speak directly with the Talent Acquisition representative.

About Q-CTRL
Q-CTRL is the global leader in AI-powered quantum control infrastructure software. We build the tools that make quantum technology useful, solving the hardest challenges in quantum computing and quantum sensing to deliver real-world impact. We’ve shown that the same enabling software which we’ve used to deliver GPS-free quantum navigation on real aircraft and drones is also able to stabilize quantum computers against errors and deliver true quantum advantage. This view makes Q-CTRL diversified index-fund bet on the entire quantum ecosystem, illustrated by the breadth of our customer engagements, from Airbus to IBM, Lockheed Martin and the Department of War to Softbank.

We work quickly to turn cutting-edge science into deployable technology. With this approach we’ve delivered the holy grail in quantum – quantum advantage – in two different domains within a year and brought commercial offerings to market on an accelerated timescale. Our teams bring together technical and multi-disciplinary expertise across the product lifecycle, and we’re hiring talent to help scale every part of the business.

Founded in 2017, we operate globally with offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Huntsville, Sydney, Berlin and Oxford. title: Executive Director, Clinical Development
description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Executive Director, Clinical Development

The Executive Director, Clinical Development will serve as the clinical lead for development program(s) and play a critical role in advancing pivotal studies, regulatory strategy, and submission readiness. This physician leader will provide medical and scientific oversight across the program lifecycle, from protocol design and study execution through data interpretation, regulatory interactions, and launch preparation.

This role requires a hands-on clinical development leader who thrives in a fast-paced biotech environment and can partner cross-functionally to drive high-quality execution with urgency.

Key Responsibilities:

Clinical Development Leadership

  • Serve as the clinical lead for one or more clinical programs, with responsibility for clinical trial design, execution oversight, and delivery of key milestones.
  • Lead development of clinical plans, protocols, amendments, , and related study documents.
  • Provide medical oversight for Phase 2/3 and/or registrational studies, ensuring patient safety, data integrity, and operational excellence.
  • Partner with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory, and Safety to ensure efficient study execution and timely issue resolution.
  • Drive study start-up, enrollment, interim analyses, database locks, topline results, and CSR delivery.

Medical Monitoring / Safety Oversight

  • Serve as medical monitor for assigned studies, including review of eligibility, protocol deviations, safety signals, SAEs/AEs, and benefit-risk assessments.
  • Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance on safety surveillance, signal detection, DSMB materials, and aggregate safety reporting.
  • Support development of risk mitigation strategies and ensure patient safety remains central throughout program execution.

Regulatory / Submission Support

  • Contribute to global regulatory strategy and interactions with health authorities (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.).
  • Author and review clinical sections of regulatory documents, including briefing books, protocols, CSRs, IBs, and submission modules.
  • Present clinical data and strategy to regulators, internal governance committees, and senior leadership.

Scientific / Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the key clinical voice on cross-functional program teams.
  • Partner with Translational Medicine, Biomarkers, Medical Affairs and Commercial to align development strategy with future launch needs.
  • Support publication planning, congress presentations, and external scientific engagement.
  • Build strong relationships with KOLs, investigators, and external experts.

Team / Culture Leadership

  • Mentor internal team members and external consultants/CRO partners.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, urgency, and quality.
  • Operate effectively in a lean biotech environment where flexibility and ownership are essential.

Experience and Qualifications:

  • MD or equivalent medical degree required; board certification preferred in Internal Medicine, Cardiology, Nephrology, Endocrinology, or related field.
  • 10+ years of industry clinical development experience, including significant late-stage / registrational trial leadership.
  • Prior experience serving as medical monitor and clinical lead for Phase 2/3 studies.
  • Proven experience with NDA / BLA submission support and health authority interactions.
  • Strong understanding of GCP, ICH guidelines, safety reporting, and global clinical development processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
  • Strong scientific communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience in hypertension, cardiovascular, renal, or metabolic disease strongly preferred.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

The opportunity

Help Scout is building a sales-led outbound motion to win more mid-market customers. Most of our pipeline comes from inbound today & we are changing that mix. This role is the engine for it.

We're hiring our first Business Development Representative to join our sales team. In this role, you’ll open conversations with the companies that fit us best and drive pipeline for our Account Executives. You'll also help shape the outbound playbook: which accounts, which messages, and which channels work. As our first BDR, we’re not looking for someone to run an established playbook… we're looking for someone who is eager to help shape one.

Does that sound like you? If so, here’s more about the role:

What you’ll do

  • Research and personalize. Use an AI tech stack to find the right prospects, from Support/Success leaders to Operations management and company executives. You'll maximize engagement by tailoring outreach using our messaging frameworks and templates, and will check AI-generated drafts before sending.

  • Work defined target account lists. Prospect into a defined list of ideal-fit mid-market companies based on our ICP criteria & strategic campaigns, and flag accounts that are not the right fit.

  • Execute multi-channel outreach. Manage outreach across several channels, including email, phone, LinkedIn, and video.

  • Test and iterate. Run messaging, personas, and channels tests, track what converts at the highest rates, and recommend changes to drive continuous improvement.

  • Report on results. Maintain updated reports and dashboards that illustrate your success rates across campaigns and performance towards your targets. Regularly review results and thoughtful recommendations for improvement with your manager.

  • Hand off cleanly. Partner closely with Account Executives to brief them on sourced meetings with well documented details about the contacts, accounts and messaging that led to the booking. Use AE feedback to regularly improve your hand-offs.

About you

  • You’re relentless and resourceful. When a prospect doesn’t answer, you find another way in: a different channel, a different person, a different angle.

  • You take initiative. You’ve built or tested something in your outbound process without being asked, and you can tell us what happened.

  • You have 1 to 2+ years as an outbound BDR or SDR at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of meeting pipeline or opportunity targets.

  • You've prospected into companies with 250+ employees and know how to tailor messaging based on industry, job title and additional criteria.

  • You’re a great communicator, both with prospects and internal colleagues.

  • You actively use AI tools in your workflow for research, list building, or writing, and can recommend what works (experience with HubSpot & GTM platforms like Apollo, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator or similar solutions a plus).

  • You can thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • You're coachable and want to grow into a closing role.

Compensation and benefits

We use a competency-based approach to pay, and pay is the same no matter where in the U.S. you live.

Base salary: $71,000 - $77,000

On-target earnings (OTE): $102,000 - $111,000

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Role Overview

The Staff Application Security Engineer leads application security strategy for Apollo’s Security department and delivers it through hands-on work and technical leadership. This role takes on the hardest AppSec problems across product, platform, and AI-powered features, including problems with no established playbook.

The role shapes the roadmaps of Engineering, Product, and Platform teams so secure patterns become the default, and sets the AppSec standard that helps many teams build securely without relying on any single person.

Key Responsibilities

AppSec strategy, standards, and influence

  • Lead Apollo’s multi-year AppSec strategy and turn it into multi-quarter, cross-team initiatives that move Security department KRs. Report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to Security leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Shape Engineering, Product, Platform, and Data roadmaps so security work is planned in early, and represent AppSec in cross-department decisions.
  • Set the secure design, code review, and risk model standards used across the department and adjacent engineering teams, including expectations for AI-generated and agent-generated code.
  • Mentor senior engineers and security champions, grow the champions program, and help raise the hiring bar, so the AppSec program does not depend on one person’s expertise.

Secure architecture and vulnerability depth

  • Lead security architecture reviews and threat modeling for ambiguous, high-scale, multi-team systems, including AI and agent features, and define the approach where no precedent exists.
  • Design and drive adoption of secure-by-default building blocks, such as shared authorization, safe OAuth and token handling, and SSRF-safe HTTP clients, so whole classes of issues stop appearing.
  • Shape vulnerability management across internal reviews, bug bounty, pentests, and SCA and runtime findings, with a focus on root causes, bug classes, and clear risk-based severity decisions.
  • Stay hands-on for the hardest cases: read code across teams, develop exploits, test bypasses, and lead variant analysis and staged remediation across teams.

Tooling, automation, and AI (AI-native by default)

  • Set the standard for AI-augmented AppSec in the department. Use AI and agents for code review, threat modeling, triage, and remediation, and build automation that teams outside Security adopt, with measured gains in speed, coverage, and signal quality.
  • Define how Apollo secures its AI systems and agent features, including input and output handling, AI-exposed APIs, prompt and response guardrails, tool permissions, and data-exfiltration paths.

What Good Looks Like (drafted from your mission and success sections)

  • Owns AppSec strategy across a multi-year horizon and gets it committed in other teams’ roadmaps.
  • Solves ambiguous, no-playbook problems and defines the approach for others to follow.
  • Makes hard risk calls under ambiguity and aligns technical and non-technical leaders without formal authority.
  • Builds guardrails, standards, and people so AppSec scales beyond any one person.

Required Skills & Experience

  • A track record of leading AppSec strategy that changed how several engineering teams build, with measurable results, typically backed by 10+ years in software engineering or application security.
  • Expert code review, penetration testing, and exploit development skills, with the ability to find design flaws in unfamiliar codebases and land fixes that hold up against bypass attempts.
  • Strong software development skills and the ability to ship production code. Ruby and Ruby on Rails experience is highly valuable, and Python is a plus. Strong Linux and cloud fundamentals, ideally GCP and Kubernetes.
  • Deep experience with secure architecture and authentication and authorization patterns, and with building security building blocks that other teams adopt.
  • Hands-on experience securing AI-powered systems or agent features, and a clear point of view on how AI changes application security.
  • The judgment to make hard risk calls under ambiguity, and the influence to align technical and non-technical leaders without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading security for AI-native products, internal agents, or AI-assisted engineering workflows at scale.
  • Experience building or scaling a security champions or developer enablement program.
  • Public security work, such as CVEs, research, talks, or open-source tools, or certifications such as OSCP or OSWE.

Example Success Outcomes

  • An AppSec strategy tied to Security department KRs, with supporting work committed in other teams’ roadmaps.
  • A measurable drop in high-risk vulnerability classes, backed by shared guardrails or libraries.
  • AI-assisted AppSec workflows adopted by teams outside Security, with clear gains in speed or signal quality.

Our Tech Stack

React on the front end; Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch on the backend; Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform in infrastructure; GCP for cloud.

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)

$259,200—$324,100 USD

Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)

$225,400—$281,800 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Business Finance
description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Business Finance Team

Business Finance helps Thumbtack make sound financial decisions and put resources where they move company goals. We partner with teams across the business to understand performance, evaluate investments and connect day-to-day decisions to financial outcomes. We work closely with Business Analytics and Corporate FP&A to turn business drivers into forecasts and practical recommendations. Our work helps teams invest in the people, products and technology that let millions of people care for their homes.

About the role

As a Senior Financial Analyst, you’ll give Product, Engineering and Design partners the financial analysis they need to plan, manage budgets and make investment decisions. You’ll report to the Senior Director of Business Finance and own recurring planning and analysis work, including headcount tracking, expense forecasting and evaluating resource trade-offs. You’ll also assess technology and infrastructure spending, including the cost of AI-powered product experiences, and help partners understand what changes in how teams work mean financially. You’ll take questions from first scoping through analysis to recommendation. You’ll work independently and draw on your manager’s guidance for more complex decisions.

What you’ll do

  • Own budget tracking and expense forecasts for assigned teams. Partner with Corporate FP&A and business stakeholders to explain variances, flag risks and opportunities, and keep plans current.

  • Track open roles, hiring assumptions and headcount allocations across teams. Model proposed changes to see what they cost and whether they fit within existing budgets.

  • Build financial models and scenario analyses to evaluate investment requests, resource allocation and changes to team structures, with clear assumptions and practical recommendations.

  • Analyze technology, infrastructure and AI usage costs, including communications platforms (e.g. Twilio) and AI token spend, to understand what drives spending and find ways to improve efficiency and allocation.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Design and Business Analytics to gather inputs, connect operational metrics to financial outcomes and assess the financial impact of business initiatives.

  • Turn analyses into clear business reviews and recommendations, surface issues early, and improve planning processes and reporting as you learn the business.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • 3+ years of experience in corporate FP&A, business finance or a similar finance business-partnering role.

  • Experience analyzing budgets, tracking expenses or headcount, and building forecasts that connect business assumptions to financial outcomes.

  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets, with attention to accuracy and clearly documented assumptions.

  • The ability to structure moderately ambiguous questions, spot missing information, and gather inputs from data and stakeholders on your own to reach a well-reasoned answer.

  • Sound judgment on costs, benefits and near-term trade-offs, including knowing when to seek guidance or escalate a risk.

  • The ability to explain financial drivers and recommendations clearly to non-finance partners, in writing and in person.

  • A track record of building collaborative relationships, following through on commitments, and finding ways to improve business outcomes or team processes.

Expected salary ranges

  • For candidates living in San Francisco / Bay Area, San Jose, New York City, or Seattle metros, the expected salary range for the role is currently $123,300.00 - $159,500.00.

  • For candidates living in Austin, TX or Washington DC metros or in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, or Washington states, the expected salary range for the role is currently $111,400.00 - $144,100.00.

  • For candidates living in all other US locations, the expected salary range for this role is currently $104,600.00 - $135,300.00.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

title: SIU Investigator, Auto Claims
description:
What you're applying for

We're looking for an experienced SIU Investigator, Auto Claims to help protect honest policyholders and keep sophisticated fraud networks from gaming the system — while making sure legitimate claims move fast. You'll join our Claims team at a pivotal moment, bringing specialized investigative expertise to high-risk files as we expand into key markets like Florida and keep pushing the boundaries of what modern fraud detection looks like.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Lead end-to-end SIU investigations on complex auto claims — Physical Damage, Bodily Injury, and PIP/Medical Payments — with full ownership from referral to resolution

  • Identify and dismantle multi-claim fraud networks, staged accident rings, and coordinated medical billing schemes using link analysis and pattern-recognition techniques

  • Partner directly with our Data Science and Product teams to test and refine predictive fraud models, feeding real-world case intelligence back into automated detection

  • Genuine curiosity about AI — both as an investigative asset and as a fraud threat vector you'll need to stay ahead of

title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience
description:

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. About the Developer Experience Team

The Developer Experience (DevEx) team makes Thumbtack's ~250 engineers more productive. We own the AI-powered developer workflows, cloud development environments, and internal developer platform the whole engineering org builds on. We're small and senior: a four-person team in Productivity Engineering, alongside Mobile Infra, Frontend Infrastructure, and Design Systems Engineering. We partner closely with engineers across the company to find their pain points and ship solutions. You can read more about our engineering culture on the Thumbtack Engineering Blog.

The challenge

We're building the infrastructure for an AI-native engineering organization, and every stream here is active work today: agentic developer tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, backed by a library of skills that encode Thumbtack-specific knowledge; a catalog of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that make our internal tools AI-accessible; and cloud development environments (CDEs) built for humans and agents alike. Alongside these, we're modernizing the Web and CLI tooling layers engineers reach for every day. A single improvement we ship can move dozens of teams forward.

What you’ll do

  • Build the platforms behind agentic developer workflows: roll out the tools the org builds on (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and ship the skills, plugins, and MCP servers that run across them.

  • Design and build the product surfaces engineers and AI agents reach for daily: self-service workflows in our Backstage developer portal, our developer CLI, IDE integrations, and the framework engineers use to build and deploy their own agents.

  • Own and evolve our Cloud Development Environment (CDE) platform for both human developers and AI agents.

  • Improve the build systems, CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, and observability the whole org depends on.

  • Prototype and evaluate new AI developer tools as they land, and decide what to adopt, configure, and scale across the engineering org.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • Demonstrated experience building developer infrastructure, DevEx, or platform tools that other engineers depend on, from CDE rollouts and internal CLIs to MCP servers and build/CI at 100+ engineer scale.

  • Strong systems thinking: you reason about build pipelines, CI/CD, dev environments, and test infrastructure as interconnected systems, not isolated tools.

  • A UX mindset applied to engineering systems: you think in personas, journeys, and end-to-end workflows, and design for the people and agents who use what you build.

  • Fluency in the languages our tooling is built in: Go and Python for CLIs, services, MCP servers, and Slackbots, plus TypeScript and React for the web UIs.

description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

About Apollo

Apollo is the AI-powered go-to-market platform that helps revenue teams find, engage, and convert their best customers. We combine a database of more than 210 million contacts and 35 million companies with an agentic end-to-end GTM platform, and more than 500,000 companies rely on us to run their go-to-market motion. We are profitable, growing fast, and rebuilding the product around AI and agents.

About Builder Studio

Builder Studio is Apollo's new product for building custom GTM software in plain English. A RevOps lead, GTM engineer, or founder describes the tool they need, and Builder Studio plans it, generates real code, and turns it into a working app they can preview, refine through conversation, publish, and share with their team.

Every app is made of four building blocks: Pages for the interface, Databases for structured records, Workflows for visible backend logic and scheduled jobs, and Agents that reason over Apollo context and take action. What makes it different from a generic app builder is that Apollo's data, enrichment, sequences, deliverability, and CRM sync are native building blocks, not bolted-on third-party integrations.

It is one of Apollo's flagship AI bets. The product is in the hands of early design partners now and is heading toward broad launch, which means the next year is about taking a working product and making it reliable, secure, and loved at scale.

Your role and mission

You will own major slices of Builder Studio end to end, across the builder experience customers see and the systems that make generated apps actually run. You will work on problems most engineers have never touched: an agent that writes and edits software on a customer's behalf, a runtime that safely executes that code with the user's own Apollo permissions, and an interface that makes all of it understandable to someone who has never read a line of code.

What you will do

  • Build the core Studio experience: the chat-driven build loop, live preview, canvas, and the publish and share flow, so a non-technical user can go from an idea to a working tool in minutes
  • Shape how the agent turns a natural-language goal into a plan, a set of pages, databases, and workflows, and then safely applies follow-up edits without breaking what already works
  • Design the runtime and workflow layer for generated apps, including triggers, scheduled jobs, retries, logging, and the line between deterministic steps and agentic steps
  • Own delegated identity, permissions, secrets, and isolation so generated apps act with exactly the access the user has, and nothing more
  • Expand "connect once, use anywhere" integrations across Apollo data (contacts, companies, lists) and external systems like Google Sheets, Google Drive, CRMs, and MCP-based connectors
  • Make the relationships between pages, data, workflows, and agents legible in the UI, so customers trust what their app is doing
  • Work directly with design partners and customers, turn their feedback into shipped improvements quickly, and help define what the product becomes
  • Raise the quality bar on a fast-moving 0 to 1 team: set patterns, write the tests and evals that matter, and own reliability, performance, and cost of what you ship

How we work: AI-native by default

You treat AI-assisted development as a core part of how you work. You use agents to move faster on design, investigation, and implementation, with clear judgment about where to review closely, and you look for ways AI raises the leverage of the whole team. On Builder Studio this is doubly true: you are building an AI that writes software, so your own instincts for where AI-generated code succeeds and fails directly shape the product.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years building and shipping production software, with real depth on both the frontend and backend of the same product
  • Strong TypeScript and React skills, including complex, stateful UIs such as editors, canvases, builders, or real-time collaborative surfaces
  • Solid backend and API design experience, ideally including event-driven or workflow systems where retries, idempotency, and observability matter
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs in production: agent loops, tool calling, context management, code generation, or evals. You know where models break and how to design around it
  • Comfort making sound security calls on systems that run untrusted or generated code: sandboxing, delegated auth, scoped tokens, and secrets handling
  • A track record of taking an ambiguous 0 to 1 product from rough prototype to something customers rely on, and making the scope-versus-quality calls that requires
  • Product instinct and empathy for non-technical users. You care whether a RevOps lead can understand what their app is doing, not just whether the code is correct
  • Genuine, current fluency with AI-assisted development and a high bar for quality and ownership

Nice to have

  • Experience building low-code, no-code, or AI app-builder products, or developer tools
  • Experience with edge or serverless runtimes such as Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects
  • Experience with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Background in GTM, sales, or marketing tech, or experience working closely with RevOps teams

Our tech stack

TypeScript and React on the front end; Ruby on Rails and Node.js on the backend; Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects for the Builder Studio runtime; Python, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch across the wider platform; Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform in infrastructure; GCP for cloud.

What you will love about Apollo

You will help build a brand new product from the ground up at a company with the data, distribution, and customer base to make it matter on day one. You will work with a small, high-bar team, own real scope, and have the AI tooling and budget to work at the top of your leverage.
